definitions.explanation: A pyramid with a quadrilateral base (typically a square or rectangle) and four triangular faces meeting at an apex. A standard solid figure introduced in middle-school geometry, familiar as the shape of the Pyramids of Giza.

examples.japanese: {四角錐|しかくすい}の{体積|たいせき}を{求|もと}める。
examples.english: Find the volume of the square pyramid.

examples.japanese: ピラミッドは{四角錐|しかくすい}の{形|かたち}をしている。
examples.english: A pyramid is shaped like a square pyramid.

examples.japanese: {四角錐|しかくすい}の{体積|たいせき}は、{底面積|ていめんせき}×{高|たか}さ÷3で{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: The volume of a square pyramid is found by multiplying the base area by the height and dividing by three.

examples.japanese: {数学|すうがく}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で、{四角錐|しかくすい}の{展開図|てんかいず}をかく{練習|れんしゅう}をした。
examples.english: In math class, we practiced drawing the net of a square pyramid.

notes:
Composed of {四角|しかく} (quadrilateral, square) and {錐|すい} (cone, pointed solid). The suffix {錐|すい} is used productively in geometric terms for pyramids and cones.

USAGE:
A technical term in geometry, appearing mainly in math textbooks, lesson materials, and science writing. Like most Japanese geometric-solid names, it is formed with a base-shape name plus {錐|すい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {四角錐|しかくすい}の{体積|たいせき}: volume of a square pyramid
- {四角錐|しかくすい}の{表面積|ひょうめんせき}: surface area of a square pyramid
- {四角錐|しかくすい}の{展開図|てんかいず}: net (unfolded diagram) of a square pyramid
- {正四角錐|せいしかくすい}: right square pyramid (with a square base and apex directly above the center)

RELATED GEOMETRIC SOLIDS:
- {三角錐|さんかくすい}: triangular pyramid, tetrahedron
- {円錐|えんすい}: cone (circular base)
- {角錐|かくすい}: pyramid (general term)
- {四角柱|しかくちゅう}: rectangular prism — the prism counterpart to {四角錐|しかくすい}
- {立方体|りっぽうたい}: cube — another common solid figure
